title: R2-W4 residual: app per-frame free_all vs stream lifetime is verified by code-reading only — the app-side placement is unpinned
evidence:
app/main.odin:182:
	app.stats_sb = strings.builder_make(context.allocator)
app/main.odin:225 (top of frame loop):
		free_all(context.temp_allocator)
core/stats.odin stats_emit signature: 'stats_emit :: proc(state: ^Run_State, cat: ^Catalogs, sim_hash: u64, sb: ^strings.Builder, allocator := context.allocator)' — builder + record arrays are default-allocated, outside temp.
detail: Sound by construction and the unit mirror (stats_stream_of hash-into-temp/append-then-free_all per tick) covers builder survival, but the app's frame-top placement and the overlay record kept across free_all boundaries have no test — app/ has no test infra (no @(test), no CI 'odin test app').
recommended_fix: Add a unit pin mirroring the app loop shape: keep a stats_emit record across a free_all(context.temp_allocator) boundary and assert record + builder bytes survive (explicit lifetime contract).

title: R2-N9 residual: the five CSV header legend lines are not pinned string-for-string — header-only drift passes every pin
evidence:
The only header-related assertion anywhere is negative — stats_test.odin:84:
	testing.expect(t, !strings.contains(out, "# pp stats stream"), "emit appends only the record, not the header")
test_stats_csv_literal_rows pins data rows only, 453-456:
	testing.expect(t, strings.contains(out, "G,7,11,f25ac71fa4b54c26,22,100\n"), "G literal: tick,gen,hash_hex,score,meter")
	testing.expect(t, strings.contains(out, "C,7,0,12,1,5,83,250,0,1\n"), "C literal: ...")
	testing.expect(t, strings.contains(out, "P,7,0,1,15,270,240,1,100,1,1,1,5,5,5,2,0,6\n"), "P literal: ...")
	testing.expect(t, strings.contains(out, "D,7,0,0,0,1\n"), "D literal: ...")
detail: The G/C/P/D literals bite (mutation-verified: a P-column swap fails test_stats_csv_literal_rows), but stats_write_header's five '#' legend lines are pinned nowhere; live and replay would carry the same drifted header, so byte-identity stays green.
recommended_fix: In test_stats_csv_literal_rows, assert the five exact header lines (including the '# D ... reason 0=Queue_Overflow' legend) string-for-string after stats_write_header.

title: Paused-wall-ticks-emit-no-rows has no discriminating pin — a symmetric both-driver regression stays byte-identical
detail: stats-check pause pins live==replay, catching one-sided regressions, but no test asserts G-row count == stepped sim ticks; moving the emit outside the pause gate in BOTH drivers fabricates paused records (stale drop sites) that remain byte-identical.
recommended_fix: Pin the row-count contract: for the pause demo assert count of 'G,' rows == number of stepped sim ticks (or last G tick == final sim tick) in stats-check or a unit pause fixture.
